# Effects

Effects are lines that do something. 57 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## Add {#add}

```carve
add %object% to %variable%
```

Adds to a number variable, or appends to a list (`add "x" and "y" to {list::*}`).

```carve
add 1 to {joins::%uuid of player%}
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Add or remove items {#inventory_items}

```carve
add %item% to %player%'s inventory
remove %item% from %player%['s inventory]
```

Adds items to, or takes up to that many items from, a player's inventory.

```carve
remove 2 diamonds from player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Apply potion effect {#apply_potion}

```carve
apply [potion of] <effect> [[of tier] %number%] to %player% [for %timespan%]
```

Gives a potion effect. The number is the tier (default 1); the time defaults to 15 seconds.

```carve
apply potion of speed 2 to player for 10 seconds
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [world-effects](../syntax/world-effects.md)

## Ban {#ban}

```carve
ban ip %object% [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
ban %object% by ip [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
ban %object% [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
```

Bans a player or name, or their IP, with an optional reason.

```carve
ban "Alex" because of "cheating"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Break block {#break_block}

```carve
(break|destroy) %block%
```

Breaks a block and updates its neighbours. No drops.

```carve
break targeted block of player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [blocks](../syntax/blocks.md)

## Broadcast {#broadcast}

```carve
broadcast %text%
```

Sends a message to every online player.

```carve
broadcast "&e%player% joined!"
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Cancel event {#cancel}

```carve
cancel [the] event
```

Stops the event. Works before the first `wait`. Some events cannot be cancelled; using it there is a load error.

```carve
on chat:
    cancel event
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Change experience {#xp}

```carve
set (xp|exp|experience|total experience) of %player% to %number%
set %player%'s (xp|exp|experience|total experience) to %number%
add %number% to (xp|exp|experience|total experience) of %player%
add %number% to %player%'s (xp|exp|experience|total experience)
add %number% (xp|exp|experience) [points] to %player%
remove %number% from (xp|exp|experience|total experience) of %player%
remove %number% from %player%'s (xp|exp|experience|total experience)
remove %number% (xp|exp|experience) [points] from %player%
give %number% (xp|exp|experience) [points] to %player%
give %player% %number% (xp|exp|experience) [points]
```

Changes total experience points. Never below 0.

```carve
give player 10 xp
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [xp-level](../syntax/xp-level.md)

## Change food level {#food}

```carve
set (food level|hunger) of %player% to %number%
set %player%'s (food level|hunger) to %number%
add %number% to (food level|hunger) of %player%
add %number% to %player%'s (food level|hunger)
remove %number% from (food level|hunger) of %player%
remove %number% from %player%'s (food level|hunger)
```

Changes the food level, 0 to 20.

```carve
remove 2 from food level of player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [health-food](../syntax/health-food.md)

## Change health {#health}

```carve
set health of %player% to %number%
set %player%'s health to %number%
add %number% to health of %player%
add %number% to %player%'s health
remove %number% from health of %player%
remove %number% from %player%'s health
```

Sets, raises or lowers health (20 = 10 hearts). Values are kept between 0 and max health; 0 kills.

```carve
set health of player to 10
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [health-food](../syntax/health-food.md)

## Change level {#level}

```carve
set (level|levels) of %player% to %number%
set %player%'s (level|levels) to %number%
add %number% to (level|levels) of %player%
add %number% to %player%'s (level|levels)
add %number% (level|levels) to %player%
remove %number% from (level|levels) of %player%
remove %number% from %player%'s (level|levels)
remove %number% (level|levels) from %player%
give %number% (level|levels) to %player%
give %player% %number% (level|levels)
```

Sets, adds or removes whole levels. Never below 0.

```carve

```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [xp-level](../syntax/xp-level.md)

## Change level progress {#level_progress}

```carve
set level progress of %player% to %number%
set %player%'s level progress to %number%
add %number% to level progress of %player%
add %number% to %player%'s level progress
remove %number% from level progress of %player%
remove %number% from %player%'s level progress
```

Changes progress to the next level, kept between 0 and 1.

```carve
set level progress of player to 0.5
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [xp-level](../syntax/xp-level.md)

## Change max health {#max_health}

```carve
set max health of %player% to %number%
set %player%'s max health to %number%
add %number% to max health of %player%
add %number% to %player%'s max health
remove %number% from max health of %player%
remove %number% from %player%'s max health
```

Changes max health. Lowering it also lowers current health when needed.

```carve

```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [health-food](../syntax/health-food.md)

## Change saturation {#saturation}

```carve
set saturation of %player% to %number%
set %player%'s saturation to %number%
add %number% to saturation of %player%
add %number% to %player%'s saturation
remove %number% from saturation of %player%
remove %number% from %player%'s saturation
```


## Clear inventory {#clear_inventory}

```carve
clear %player%'s [current] inventory
```

Empties the player's inventory, armor and off hand included, or the open menu.

```carve
clear player's inventory
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Close inventory {#close_inventory}

```carve
close %player%'s inventory
```

Loads, but does nothing yet: plugin API v0.1 has no call to close a window. A warning is logged.

```carve
close player's inventory
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Create explosion {#explosion}

```carve
create [an] explosion [(of force|with power) %number%] [with fire] at %location%
```

Makes an explosion that breaks blocks like TNT. Default force 3, max 100.

```carve
create explosion of force 3 at player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [world-effects](../syntax/world-effects.md)

## Damage {#damage}

```carve
damage %player% by %number%
```

Hurts the player with generic damage.

```carve
damage player by 2
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [health-food](../syntax/health-food.md)

## Delete {#delete}

```carve
delete %variable%
```

Deletes a variable, or a whole list with `{list::*}`.

```carve
delete {home::%uuid of player%}
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Display name {#display_name}

```carve
set (display name|nickname) of %object% to %text%
set %object%'s (display name|nickname) to %text%
reset (display name|nickname) of %object%
reset %object%'s (display name|nickname)
```

Sets or resets a player's display name. Color codes work.

```carve
set display name of player to "&6Boss"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Execute console command {#console_command}

```carve
execute console command %text%
```

Runs a server command as the console, right after the script finishes.

```carve
execute console command "say hi"
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Exit loop / continue {#exit_loop}

```carve
(exit|stop) loop
break
continue
```

Leaves the innermost loop, or skips to its next round.

```carve
loop 10 times:
    if loop-number is 5:
        exit loop
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [loops](../syntax/loops.md)

## Feed {#feed}

```carve
feed %player% [by %number%]
```

Fills food level and saturation to 20, or adds to the food level.

```carve
feed player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [health-food](../syntax/health-food.md)

## Give item {#give}

```carve
give %number% [of] %item% to %player%
give %item% to %player%
give %player% %item%
```

Gives items to a player. Item names are checked when the script loads.

```carve
give 2 diamonds to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Heal {#heal}

```carve
heal %player%
heal %player% by %number%
```

Heals to full health, or adds that much health up to the max.

```carve
heal player by 4
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [health-food](../syntax/health-food.md)

## If / else {#if}

```carve
if %condition%:
else if %condition%:
else:
```

Runs the indented block when the condition is true. A condition on its own line stops the trigger when false.

```carve
if {coins::%uuid of player%} >= 10:
    send "rich" to player
else:
    send "poor" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)

## Ignite / extinguish {#ignite}

```carve
ignite %player% [for %timespan%]
set %player% on fire [for %timespan%]
extinguish %player%
```

Sets a player on fire (default 5 seconds) or puts the fire out.

```carve
ignite player for 5 seconds
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [world-effects](../syntax/world-effects.md)

## Kick {#kick}

```carve
kick %object% [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
```

Kicks a player, with an optional reason.

```carve
kick player due to "bad vibes"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Kill {#kill}

```carve
kill %player%
```

Kills the player.

```carve
kill player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Loop list {#loop_list}

```carve
loop %list%:
loop %object%, %object% and %object%:
loop all players:
```

Runs the block for each item, value or online player. Gives `loop-value`, `loop-index` or `loop-player`.

```carve
loop all players:
    send "Restart in 1 minute" to loop-player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [loops](../syntax/loops.md)

## Loop times {#loop_times}

```carve
loop %number% times:
```

Runs the block N times. `loop-number` counts from 1.

```carve
loop 3 times:
    send "Round %loop-number%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [loops](../syntax/loops.md)

## Make execute command {#make_execute}

```carve
make %object% execute [the] [command] %text%
force %object% to execute [the] [command] %text%
execute [the] command %text% by %object%
execute [the] command %text%
```

Runs a command as a player (their permissions apply) or the console. A leading `/` is ignored. Without `by` it runs as the console.

```carve
make player execute command "/spawn"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [senders](../syntax/senders.md)

## Op / deop {#op}

```carve
op %object%
deop %object%
```

Gives or takes operator status, through the server's own command. Works for offline names.

```carve
op player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Open chest menu {#open_chest}

```carve
open [a] chest with %number% (row|rows) [(named|titled|called|with title) %text%] (to|for) %player%
```

Opens an empty chest menu with 1 to 6 rows. Fill it with `set slot`.

```carve
open chest with 3 rows named "Shop" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Particles {#particles}

```carve
(play|show|draw|spawn|create|make) [%number%] <particle> particles at %location% [with spread %number%] [with speed %number%]
```

Shows particles. The name is the Minecraft particle id with spaces and is checked at load. Count defaults to 1, max 1000.

```carve
show 20 happy villager particles at player with spread 0.5
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [world-effects](../syntax/world-effects.md)

## Play sound {#play_sound}

```carve
play [the] (sound|sounds) %text% [(at|with) volume %number%] [(and|and at|and with|at|with) pitch %number%] [(to|for) %player%] [at %location%]
```

Plays a sound id to a player, or at a location for everyone. Volume 0 or more, pitch 0 to 2.

```carve
play sound "block.note_block.pling" with volume 0.5 and pitch 2 to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [sounds](../syntax/sounds.md)

## Remove {#remove}

```carve
remove %object% from %variable%
```

Subtracts from a number variable, or removes every equal item from a list.

```carve
remove 5 from {coins::%uuid of player%}
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Remove potion effects {#remove_potion}

```carve
remove all potion effects from %player%
remove [the] <effect> potion effect from %player%
```

Removes one potion effect or all of them.

```carve
remove all potion effects from player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [world-effects](../syntax/world-effects.md)

## Replace text {#replace}

```carve
replace first %text% in %variable% with %text%
replace first %text% with %text% in %variable%
replace [all] %text% in %variable% with %text%
replace [all] %text% with %text% in %variable%
```

Replaces text inside a text variable. Matching is exact and case sensitive.

```carve
set {_t} to "a-b-c"
replace all "-" with " " in {_t}
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [text-join-split](../syntax/text-join-split.md)

## Return {#return}

```carve
return [%object%]
```

Gives back a value from a function. Its type must match the return type.

```carve
function double(n: number) :: number:
    return {_n} * 2
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [functions](../syntax/functions.md)

## Send action bar {#action_bar}

```carve
send action bar %text% to %player%
```

Shows text just above the hotbar.

```carve
send action bar "&7Coins: %{coins::%uuid of player%}%" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Send message {#send}

```carve
send %text% [to %player%]
```

Sends a message. Without `to` it goes to whoever started the trigger. `to console` writes to the server log. Color codes work.

```carve
send "&aHello %player%!" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Send title {#title}

```carve
send title %text% [with subtitle %text%] to %player%
```

Shows a big title, with an optional subtitle, on the player's screen.

```carve
send title "Welcome" with subtitle "to the server" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Set {#set}

```carve
set %variable% to %object%
```

Stores a value in a variable. `set {list::*} to a, b and c` replaces a whole list.

```carve
set {spawn} to location of player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Set block {#set_block}

```carve
set %block% to %item%
```

Places a block of that type. Any block form works on the left.

```carve
set block below player to diamond block
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [blocks](../syntax/blocks.md)

## Set gamemode {#gamemode}

```carve
set gamemode of %player% to %text% [mode]
set game mode of %player% to %text% [mode]
set %player%'s gamemode to %text% [mode]
set %player%'s game mode to %text% [mode]
```

Changes the game mode. The mode can be a word, text, a number 0 to 3 or a short form (`s`, `c`, `a`, `sp`).

```carve
set gamemode of player to creative
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [gamemode](../syntax/gamemode.md)

## Set slot {#set_slot}

```carve
set slot %number% of %inventory% to %item%
```

Puts an item in a slot (counted from 0). `air` empties it. `player's current inventory` is the open Carve menu.

```carve
set slot 4 of player's current inventory to diamond
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Sort list {#sort}

```carve
sort %list% [in descending order]
```

Sorts a list in place. Numbers sort by value, before text.

```carve
set {_n::*} to 3, 1 and 2
sort {_n::*}
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [list-ops](../syntax/list-ops.md)

## Stop {#stop}

```carve
stop
```

Ends the whole trigger, or a function that returns nothing.

```carve
if player does not have permission "vip":
    stop
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [loops](../syntax/loops.md)

## Stop sound {#stop_sound}

```carve
stop all sounds [(for|from) %player%]
stop [the] (sound|sounds) %text% [(for|from) %player%]
```

Stops one sound or all sounds for a player.

```carve
stop all sounds for player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [sounds](../syntax/sounds.md)

## Strike lightning {#lightning}

```carve
strike lightning [effect] at %location%
show [a] lightning effect at %location%
```

Strikes a real bolt. With `effect` it is only the flash and sound.

```carve
strike lightning effect at player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [world-effects](../syntax/world-effects.md)

## Tab list name {#tab_list_name}

```carve
set tab list name of %object% to %text%
set %object%'s tab list name to %text%
reset tab list name of %object%
reset %object%'s tab list name
```

Sets or resets the name shown in the tab list.

```carve
set tab list name of player to "&a[VIP] %player%"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Teleport {#teleport}

```carve
teleport %player% to %number%, %number%, %number%
```

Teleports the player to coordinates in their current world.

```carve
teleport player to 0, 64, 0
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Teleport to location {#teleport_location}

```carve
teleport %player% to %location%
```

Teleports the player to a location. A location without a world keeps the player in their world.

```carve
teleport player to location(0, 64, 0, world "world")
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Unban {#unban}

```carve
(unban|pardon) ip %object%
(unban|pardon) %object%
```

Lifts a ban or an IP ban.

```carve
unban "Alex"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Wait {#wait}

```carve
wait %number% (tick|ticks)
wait %number% (second|seconds)
wait %timespan%
```

Pauses the run without blocking the server. A timespan is rounded to the nearest tick.

```carve
wait 5 seconds
send "5 seconds later" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [timespans](../syntax/timespans.md)

## While loop {#while}

```carve
while %condition%:
```

Runs the block while the condition holds. Checked before every round.

```carve
set {_i} to 0
while {_i} < 5:
    add 1 to {_i}
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [loops](../syntax/loops.md)
